phase: final bounded static review of exact diagnostic runner/workflow/probe

findings.classification: CONFIRMED STATIC ACQUISITION GAP, CORRECTION REVIEWED
findings.original: Initial runner wrote result.json only after all six subprocess launches and final source reads; unhandled launch OSError could discard the packaging route for already captured evidence because the always-packager required that final result.
findings.current: Initial, prelaunch-intent and terminal atomic checkpoints plus caught OSError preserve partial capture. Archive mode saves the raw directory before reading fixture rows and handles missing/unparseable JSON. No real execution of this path by reviewer.

findings.original: Six 240-second case deadlines leave only one minute within the former 25-minute job for checkout/runtime download/packaging.
findings.current: 35-minute job provides 11 minutes beyond the summed 24-minute case deadlines. This is an acquisition margin, not a guarantee of artifact capture after forced whole-job cancellation.

findings.classification: CONFIRMED STATIC CLI PREMISE MISMATCH; CORRECTION REVIEWED
findings.original: Runner a9d61 constructs a new nonexistent r15d OutputRoot; probe 2828 required that directory already exist, so every launch would fail before the intended native observation. Ordinary inherited-owner mkdir would not by itself establish product TrustedParent.
findings.evidence: Original probe line 243 and runner line 80; native4 saved ambient Temp is Administrators-owned TrustedAncestor=true/TrustedParent=false.
findings.correction: Final probe owns fixture setup: it holds actual Open-CompilerDirectoryLease handles for every existing ancestor and requires actual TrustedAncestor replacement safety plus NTFS/persistent ACLs. It exclusively creates OutputRoot with current-user protected descriptor using actual emitted CreateDirectoryW, verifies Private readback, and then passes that new self-owned parent to unchanged production New-StagingCompilerContext. Existing paths are not adopted; no ancestor ACL or ownership is repaired.

findings.original: Both native type absence flags were only recorded, so a preloaded type could skip the intended baseline compilation without triggering acquisition failure. No such native survivor was observed.
findings.correction: Final child requires both recorded absence flags before fixture checks. The later inspection warms CompilerNative, which is explicitly a diagnostic setup effect; StageNative compilation remains cold.

findings.original: Join-Path was used to construct the 259/260/261/268-character target before the actual CreatePrivateFile call. A provider-level failure could obscure the intended native boundary; no new native failure was claimed.
findings.correction: Final probe concatenates the path as a string, verifies UTF-16 length and component length, and calls the actual StageNative.CreatePrivateFile. Extended-prefix retry happens only after a failed bare call plus native absent code 2/3; observed existing/collision objects are never presented as a successful prefix experiment.

findings.original: Parent strict UTF-8 decoding lacked explicit encoding in the child probe. Existing campaign evidence already demonstrated locale-based stdout corruption. This review did not execute a new counterexample.
findings.correction: Final 736907 differs from bdc3 only by setting Console.OutputEncoding to the existing BOM-free UTF-8 encoder before any console JSON. Raw streams and exact UTF-8 receipt bytes remain preserved.

findings.original: Encoding.Default.CodePage was labelled defaultAnsiCodePage, which could overstate a Windows ACP observation on a non-Framework host.
findings.correction: Final probe labels the measured property encodingDefaultCodePage, including the child reporter. No Windows ACP API measurement is inferred.

checks.name: diagnostic claim boundary

limits: Reviewer executed no Python test, PowerShell, native compiler, workflow, installer, or target probe. Python was used only to read/hash/diff and write this report.
Final author receipt is parse-only under Linux PS7.6.6; no native Windows execution or successful production behavior is established.
The input source remains f801. A native diagnostic finding requires exact new artifact/source/fixture/host receiving and is not pre-approved by this report.

The wrapper records cold CompilerNative at child start, then invokes it for read-only fixture/native observations before Initialize-StagingNative. This is a cold StageNative compilation diagnostic, not an untouched first-entry bootstrap or complete production command.

Snapshots are bounded and expose complete/error fields. In particular, absence after actual successful cleanup is an expected snapshot failure. Readers must inspect per-stage facts; top diagnostic acquisition does not certify that every optional observation succeeded.

The inner CodeDOM environment reporter and direct compiler are diagnostic boundary controls. They cannot substitute for actual installer success and do not establish a global filesystem/network effect trace.

Runner receipt existence and zero process exit are only acquisition prerequisites. Independent receiving must parse, validate exact source/test/host/mode and reconcile original versus copied bytes before using observations.
Parent/descendant timeout scope is explicit. A tree archived after timeout is a snapshot unless terminal state is independently established; no output is silently credited as accepted native proof.
No same-user/admin isolation, global egress denial, real browser installation, reboot persistence, complete original/amended denominator closure or release authority is claimed.
disposition: No additional concrete blocker remains in the exact reviewed diagnostic packet for root-controlled native observation. This is a bounded static review, not native qualification, acceptance, publication authorization or a production correction.
